description: This file defines an abstract class 'OA_DB_AdvisoryLock' for managing advisory locks within the Openads (Revive Adserver) project, including lock types, factory method for lock instances, and lock management methods.

classes.name: OA_DB_AdvisoryLock
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for advisory lock mechanisms in Openads, supporting lock acquisition, release, and ID management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the lock object with a singleton database connection.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Returns an instance of the best supported advisory lock class based on the database type, with fallback to file locking.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock of a specified type, generating a lock ID.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the currently held lock, if any.

methods.name: hasSameId
methods.description: Checks if the lock ID matches the given lock type.

methods.name: _isLockingSupported
methods.description: Indicates whether the current lock implementation supports locking (default true).

methods.name: _getLock
methods.description: Private method placeholder for acquiring a lock; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: _releaseLock
methods.description: Private method placeholder for releasing a lock; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: _getId
methods.description: Generates a unique lock ID based on database DSN and configuration prefix.
